explication: Douyin-Vue is a mobile Vue imitation of TikTok, centered on browsing short videos and navigating into social, profile, messaging, music, and shopping experiences. The app mounts a routed, cached interface; its Pinia store initializes profile and friend data through user APIs. README documents locally stored data and mocked API responses, though the mock implementation is outside the supplied tree. Several routes and the home/video implementation were not excerpted, so the graph preserves those documented or tree-supported product areas without guessing their internal call paths.
